subject: Mutual plan & security mileposts — FinVault close trajectory
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finvault.com>, Tom Hale <tom.hale@finvault.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Mutual plan & security mileposts — FinVault close trajectory

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Per our conversation I sketched a short mutual action plan that captures the security/compliance gates we expect during evaluation and the suggested close timeline. High-level asks below — I attached MAP_FinVault_v1.pdf with milestones.

Key security/compliance checkpoints we need to align on within the MAP:
- SOC 2: confirm scope (Hosted API only vs Hosted+Dedicated), requested timeline for receiving the most recent Type II report or bridge letter.
- SIG / CAIQ: FinVault to review our completed questionnaire (we've attached answers), and confirm any supplemental evidence items you require.
- DPA: we propose signing our standard DPA with a data residency addendum; highlight any carveouts you need (e.g., processor/sub-processor list).
- Data retention & residency: confirm the retention windows for logs, request/response traces, and backups (default Redwood staging retention is 90 days for request traces; options for 1/3/7 years with escrow).

Proposed close trajectory (high level):
- Week 0: MAP alignment + SIG exchange
- Week 1–2: Evidence intake / SOC2 / SIG follow-up
- Week 3: Final DPA redlines and signatures
- Week 4: Customer POC kickoff (subject to DPA + acceptance checklist)

Can you confirm: 1) whether SOC 2 coverage is sufficient for your procurement, 2) desired retention window for request traces and logs, and 3) anyone else on your side who should be on the MAP?

Attachments: MAP_FinVault_v1.pdf (milestones), Redwood_SIG_export_v1.xlsx (answers)

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick 30m call if helpful.

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Tom Hale <tom.hale@finvault.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finvault.com>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan & security mileposts — FinVault close trajectory

Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from procurement/security here at FinVault:
1) SOC 2: we need Type II report covering the Hosted API and the auth/token flows. If you have a current bridge letter that calls out the exact control set, please attach.
2) Data residency: our legal asks EU residency for any persisted customer data. We can accept US-hosted for ephemeral forwarding but persisted logs must be in EU for our production rollout.
3) Retention: primary ask is 1 year for request traces and 7 years for audit logs. Is that supported?

I attached our half-completed SIG template to speed reviews (FinVault_SIG_responses_v0.9.xlsx) — you'll see we marked a few items where we need vendor evidence or a readiness statement.

We can make a decision quickly if SOC 2 scope + DPA and residency align. I’m available Mon morning for a 30m MW call.

—
Tom Hale
Head of Procurement | FinVault
tom.hale@finvault.com

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hale <tom.hale@finvault.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan & security mileposts — FinVault close trajectory

Tom / Vanessa —

Thanks for the details, Tom. Quick responses inline and a short list of artifacts we can provide immediately:

SOC 2
- Scope: Hosted API + token/auth flows can be explicitly included; our last Type II statement covers production Hosted API and data plane controls. We will attach the report or bridge letter depending on availability.
- Evidence: control narratives, SOC2 type II PDF (redacted as needed), and list of in-scope sub-processors.

SIG / CAIQ
- We received your FinVault_SIG_responses_v0.9.xlsx — noted items 2.4, 3.1, and 7.2 needing evidence. We can provide: flow diagrams for network segregation, KMS configuration doc, and ISO/PCI scoping statements where applicable.

DPA & Residency
- DPA: our standard DPA contains a data residency addendum. For EU residency of persisted customer data we propose: a) Hosted EU region (customer project), b) encryption-at-rest with EU keys (KMS in region), and c) contractual assurance clauses.
- Retention: Redwood supports configurable retention tiers. Pragmatic options: 90d / 1y / 7y for request traces and audit logs. 7y for audit logs is feasible but will require an enterprise retention tier (pricing note in MAP).

Immediate ask for FinVault: confirm final retention selection (1y vs 7y) and whether you require EU KMS key residency. If yes to both, we will: 1) add EU-residency milestone to MAP_v2 and 2) include an enterprise retention line item for pricing.

Delivery timeline (what Redwood can do quickly)
- Within 48 hours: send SOC2 / bridge letter (if available) + control narratives
- Within 5 business days: deliver the annotated SIG evidence bundle (network diagrams, KMS config, subprocessors list)
- DPA redline turnaround: 3–5 business days after receiving your redlines

If that works, Vanessa — I’ll prepare a MAP_v2 with the EU-residency milestone and retention pricing options and send to Tom/Samantha for sign-off.

—
Soojin Lee
Information Security | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Hale <tom.hale@finvault.com>, Samantha Ortiz <samantha.ortiz@finvault.com>

Date: Fri, 31 Jul 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Mutual plan & security mileposts — FinVault close trajectory

Tom / Samantha —

Appreciate the quick turn. I’ve consolidated the changes into MAP_FinVault_v2.pdf (attached) — highlights:
- EU residency milestone added for persisted customer data (we’ll schedule a short intake to confirm the exact buckets to persist in-region).
- Retention tiers listed (default 90d / optional 1y / enterprise 7y with pricing).
- SIG evidence delivery dates and SOC2 delivery commitment (Soojin will send evidence bundle within 5 business days).
- DPA: we’ll accept a few customer redlines; please send specific redline doc and we’ll respond within 3 business days.

Next steps / asks from FinVault:
1) Confirm retention selection (please pick 1y or 7y) — this will determine the pricing line in the MAP.
2) Share DPA redlines (we’ll route to legal + security).
3) Confirm a 30m sync: proposed Mon 02 Aug 2026, 10:00–10:30 PT. Let me know if another time works.

If all three align we’ll move to signature-targeted week 3 and POC kickoff in week 4 (as noted).

Thanks — attached final: MAP_FinVault_v2.pdf

—
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123
